1. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel, forming an inner panel-extension joint, and attached to the door outer panel via a non-hemmed joint, forming an outer panel-extension joint, to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the inner panel-extension joint includes fasteners securing the panel extension to the common door inner panel, and wherein the fasteners are rivets.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel and attached to the door outer panel, wherein the panel extension is selectively replaceable with an alternative panel extension configured to mate with an alternative door outer panel to secure the common door inner panel to the alternative door outer panel.

6. (Original)

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein step (b) is further defined by attaching the panel extension to the door outer panel via a non-hemmed joint.
